provenance.unit: Google TN rows whose written token is exactly four ASCII digits and whose corpus class is DATE, CARDINAL, or DIGIT
provenance.bucket: the token's first two digits; raw counts, with no year window
provenance.profile_bucket: development-selected decade, numeric structure and neighboring context classes; raw counts, with century fallback
provenance.profile_unit: eligible rows classified by the year, cardinal or digit alternative whose normalized text matches the corpus spoken form
